notes: Existing complete-input predictions only; no new GPU inference.
phasekv90_previous is prior P90, not a new BetterMemory quality result. LongGen48 is reused selection data.
Scores are paired sample means (0-100); each bucket has its own Full comparison. Task mix differs across buckets.
CI resamples prompts within tasks, preserves task counts, 10000 repetitions, exploratory, unadjusted for multiple testing. Tiny strata are unreliable.
RULER two NIAH tasks use SnapKV1024/window16/kernel5; VT/CWE use2048/window32/kernel7; do not label all64 as SnapKV2048.
Long input and long output are separate factors; LongGenBench is not evidence of a controlled input-length effect.
